name: Orwashers Bakery
dsc: Orwashers Bakery offers a curated selection of artisanal breads baked fresh daily using traditional methods and high-quality ingredients. This 3-pack allows you to choose your favorite varieties from their extensive collection, including sourdough, rye, multigrain, and ciabatta. Each loaf is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, resulting in a crispy crust and a soft, airy interior. Perfect for sandwiches, toast, or enjoying with butter and jam, these breads bring the authentic taste of a New York City bakery straight to your home.

name: Grateful Bread Company
dsc: Grateful Bread Company's 4-pack artisanal bread selection allows you to explore a variety of handcrafted loaves made with organic flours and natural starters. Choose from sourdough, whole wheat, olive rosemary, and seeded rye, each baked to perfection with a golden, crisp crust and a tender crumb. These breads are versatile and pair beautifully with cheeses, soups, and salads.

name: Calic Bread
dsc: Calic Bread's Corn Cheese Bread is a Korean-inspired creation that combines sweet corn kernels with creamy mozzarella cheese baked into a soft, pillowy bread. The combination of savory cheese and sweet corn creates a delightful contrast that is both comforting and addictive. This 2-pack is perfect for sharing with family and friends.

name: Tartine Bakery
dsc: Tartine Bakery is renowned for its exceptional sourdough bread, made with a century-old starter and organic flour. This 2-pack lets you choose from their signature country loaf, whole wheat, rye, or seeded varieties. Each loaf has a beautifully caramelized crust and an open, airy crumb that is perfect for any meal.

name: Craftsman and Wolves
dsc: Craftsman and Wolves' Japanese Milk Bread is incredibly soft, fluffy, and slightly sweet, making it the perfect bread for sandwiches, toast, or simply enjoying with butter. Made with a tangzhong method, this bread stays fresh longer and has a pillowy texture that is irresistible. This 2-loaf pack is a must-have for bread lovers.

name: Orwashers Bakery
dsc: Orwashers Bakery's 6-pack artisanal bread selection is ideal for those who love variety. Choose from a wide range of breads including sourdough, rye, baguettes, and specialty loaves. Each bread is handcrafted using time-honored techniques and the finest ingredients.

name: Arcangeli Grocery
dsc: Arcangeli Grocery's Artichoke Bread Sampler is a California favorite. This 4-pack includes their famous artichoke bread, a savory loaf packed with marinated artichoke hearts, garlic, and herbs. It's perfect for toasting, serving with pasta, or enjoying as a snack.

name: Milwaukee Pretzel Company
dsc: Milwaukee Pretzel Company's Bavarian Soft Pretzel Twists are a classic German-style snack. Each pretzel is hand-rolled, dipped in lye, and baked to a deep golden brown, resulting in a chewy exterior and soft interior. This 10-pack is perfect for parties, game days, or any gathering.

name: Maui Banana Bread Co
dsc: Maui Banana Bread Co's 6-pack of mini banana bread loaves are made with fresh, locally grown bananas and a secret family recipe. These loaves are moist, flavorful, and packed with tropical goodness. Choose from classic banana, chocolate chip, or macadamia nut varieties.

name: Antique Bar & Bakery
dsc: Antique Bar & Bakery's stuffed bread loaves are a gourmet treat filled with delicious ingredients like cheese, meats, and vegetables. This 2-pack allows you to choose from a variety of fillings, each baked into a crusty loaf that is perfect for slicing and serving.

name: Stella's of Madison
dsc: Stella's of Madison's Hot & Spicy Cheese Bread is a Wisconsin classic. This bread is packed with spicy jalapeños and melted cheddar cheese, baked to a golden brown with a crispy, cheesy top. Perfect for serving with soups, chili, or enjoying on its own.

name: Grateful Bread Company
dsc: Grateful Bread Company's Savory Bread Assortment features four delicious loaves, each with a unique flavor profile. Choose from rosemary olive oil, roasted garlic, sun-dried tomato, and cracked black pepper. These breads are perfect for pairing with cheese and charcuterie.

name: Boudin Bakery
dsc: Boudin Bakery's Classic Clam Chowder and Bread Bowls Kit is a San Francisco favorite. This kit includes four sourdough bread bowls and four servings of creamy clam chowder, made with fresh clams, potatoes, and a rich broth. Perfect for a cozy meal at home.

name: Bread and Roses Bakery
dsc: Bread and Roses Bakery's Care Package is a thoughtful gift featuring a selection of their finest baked goods. Includes artisan loaves, pastries, and sweet treats. Perfect for sending a little love to friends and family.

name: Claudio's Specialty Breads
dsc: Claudio's Specialty Breads offers a 16-pack of gourmet breadsticks in a variety of flavors, including garlic, parmesan, and rosemary. These crispy, crunchy breadsticks are perfect for snacking, serving with dips, or adding to a charcuterie board.

name: Kossar's Bagels & Bialys
dsc: Kossar's Bagels & Bialys offers a 2-pack of authentic babka, a sweet, braided bread that is rich and buttery. Choose from chocolate or cinnamon varieties, each swirled with a delicious filling and baked to a golden brown. Perfect for breakfast or dessert.

name: Calic Bread
dsc: Calic Bread's Original Garlic Cream Cheese Bread is a savory delight. The bread is filled with a creamy garlic and cheese mixture, then baked until the top is golden and crispy. This 2-pack is perfect for serving alongside pasta or enjoying as a snack.

name: High Street Philadelphia
dsc: High Street Philadelphia's artisanal bread 2-pack features two handcrafted loaves made with locally sourced flour and a slow fermentation process. Choose from sourdough, whole wheat, or country-style loaves, each with a crisp crust and a flavorful crumb.

name: Orwashers Bakery
dsc: Orwashers Bakery's Best Sellers 3-pack includes their most popular breads: the classic sourdough, the hearty rye, and the versatile multigrain. Each loaf is baked fresh and delivers exceptional flavor and texture.

name: Tomaro's Bakery
dsc: Tomaro's Bakery Italian Bread is a classic, crusty loaf that is perfect for pasta dinners, sandwiches, and dipping in olive oil. This 2-pack brings the authentic taste of an Italian bakery to your table, with a soft, airy interior and a golden, crispy crust.

name: Essa Bagel
dsc: Essa Bagel's Baker's Dozen features 13 freshly baked, kosher bagels made using traditional methods. These bagels are boiled and baked to achieve a chewy texture and a crisp crust. Choose from a variety of flavors like plain, everything, sesame, and poppy.

name: Ceci-Cela Patisserie
dsc: Ceci-Cela Patisserie's Pain au Chocolat are a French classic. These buttery, flaky pastries are filled with rich chocolate and baked to a perfect golden brown. This 8-pack is perfect for breakfast, brunch, or an afternoon treat.

name: Claudio's Specialty Breads
dsc: Claudio's Specialty Breads 15-lb pack of gourmet breadsticks is ideal for large events, restaurants, or serious snacking. This bulk pack offers a variety of flavors and ensures you always have a delicious, crunchy snack on hand.

name: Milwaukee Pretzel Company
dsc: The Milwaukee Pretzel Company's Pretzel Lover's Combo Pack includes a variety of pretzel products, including soft twists, bites, and sticks. Each is made with traditional Bavarian recipes and is perfect for dipping in cheese sauce or mustard.

name: Calic Bread
dsc: Calic Bread's Korean Cream Cheese Bread Combo is a delicious fusion of sweet and savory. The bread is filled with a creamy, slightly sweet cheese mixture and topped with a crumbly streusel. This 2-pack is a must-try for adventurous eaters.

name: Stella's of Madison
dsc: Stella's of Madison's Hot & Spicy Cheese Bread 4-pack is perfect for large gatherings. Each loaf is packed with spicy jalapeños and melted cheddar, baked to perfection. A Wisconsin favorite for game day and parties.

name: State Street Brats
dsc: State Street Brats' Bavarian Pretzel Buns are soft, chewy, and perfect for sandwiches or burgers. These buns are made using traditional pretzel techniques, giving them a distinct flavor and texture. This 12-pack is great for cookouts.

name: Miller's Bakery
dsc: Miller's Bakery Scratch Made Raisin Bread is a classic, comforting loaf filled with plump, sweet raisins and a hint of cinnamon. This 2-pack is perfect for toasting and enjoying with butter or cream cheese for breakfast or a snack.

name: Tartine Bakery
dsc: Tartine Bakery's 4-pack allows you to sample a wider variety of their artisanal loaves. Choose from country sourdough, whole wheat, rye, and seeded options. Each loaf is a testament to Tartine's commitment to quality.

name: Arcangeli Grocery
dsc: Arcangeli Grocery's Pescadero Breads Sampler includes four of their most popular loaves, including the famous artichoke bread, herb bread, and more. Perfect for those who want to explore the flavors of the California coast.

name: Utopia Bagels
dsc: Utopia Bagels' New York Bagel Brunch Kit includes 12 bagels (6 + 6 free), along with cream cheese, lox, and all the classic toppings. This kit is perfect for a weekend brunch with family and friends, bringing the authentic New York bagel experience to your table.

name: Breads Bakery
dsc: Breads Bakery's Chocolate Babka is a New York City icon. This 3-pack includes three loaves of rich, buttery babka filled with layers of dark chocolate, baked to a golden brown with a crispy, sugary topping. A true delight for chocolate lovers.

name: LAVO
dsc: LAVO's Signature Garlic Bread with Sauces is an elevated take on a classic. Each bread is brushed with a roasted garlic butter, then baked until crispy and golden. Served with a selection of dipping sauces, this is the perfect appetizer for any meal.

name: Claudio's Specialty Breads
dsc: Claudio's Specialty Breads 4-pack of gourmet breadsticks includes a selection of their most popular flavors, including garlic, cheese, and herb. These breadsticks are crisp, flavorful, and perfect for snacking or serving with soups and salads.

name: Ess-a-Bagel
dsc: Ess-a-Bagel's Buy 1 Get 1 Free offer on their classic kosher bagels is an amazing deal. You get two dozen freshly baked bagels in your choice of flavors. These bagels are chewy, flavorful, and perfect for any meal.

name: Charm City Kosher
dsc: Charm City Kosher's Frozendorf Ready-to-Bake Braided Challah is a convenient way to enjoy fresh, homemade challah. This 2-pack of frozen, pre-braided dough is ready to bake and fills your home with the warm, comforting aroma of fresh bread.

name: Arcangeli Grocery
dsc: Arcangeli Grocery's Artichoke Bread 4-pack allows you to choose your favorite artichoke bread flavors. These loaves are packed with artichoke hearts, garlic, and herbs, and are perfect for any meal or snack.

name: The Gingered Peach
dsc: The Gingered Peach's Zucchini Bread Loaf Cake is a moist and delicious treat that is perfect for breakfast, dessert, or a snack. This 2-pack includes two loaves of zucchini bread, packed with walnuts and warm spices.

name: Milwaukee Pretzel Company
dsc: Milwaukee Pretzel Company's 100-pack of Bavarian Soft Pretzel Bites is perfect for large events. These bite-sized pretzels are soft, chewy, and salty, and are sure to be a hit at any party or gathering. Great with cheese sauce or mustard.

name: Breads Bakery
dsc: Breads Bakery's Chocolate and Cinnamon Babka 3-pack offers the best of both worlds. Enjoy two rich chocolate babkas and one classic cinnamon babka, each swirled with a delicious filling and baked to perfection. A perfect gift for any occasion.

name: Butterflake Bakery
dsc: Butterflake Bakery's Pretzel Challah is a unique twist on a classic. This 3-pack features challah bread that has been boiled in a lye solution and baked, giving it a pretzel-like crust and a soft, fluffy interior. A delicious fusion of two favorites.

name: Kossar's Bagels & Bialys
dsc: Kossar's Bagels & Bialys Combo Pack includes 6 bagels and 6 bialys, offering a taste of two New York City favorites. Bialys are similar to bagels but have a soft, chewy center with a caramelized onion filling. A great variety pack.

name: Zaro's Family Bakery
dsc: Zaro's Family Bakery Hand Braided Challah is a beautiful and delicious bread perfect for Shabbat, holidays, or any special occasion. Each loaf is carefully braided and baked to a deep golden brown, with a soft, airy interior and a slightly sweet flavor.

name: Ceci-Cela Patisserie
dsc: Ceci-Cela Patisserie's Fresh Butter Croissants are a French classic. These 16 croissants are made with high-quality butter and baked to perfection, resulting in a flaky, golden, and buttery pastry. Perfect for breakfast, brunch, or a luxurious snack.

name: Arcangeli Grocery
dsc: Arcangeli Grocery's Pesto Artichoke Bread is a flavorful twist on their classic artichoke bread. This 4-pack features a rich pesto sauce along with artichoke hearts and cheese, creating a savory loaf that is perfect for any meal.

name: Oneg Bakery
dsc: Oneg Bakery's Double Chocolate Babka is a chocolate lover's dream. This rich, buttery bread is filled with layers of dark chocolate, then baked to a golden brown with a crispy, sugary top. The result is a decadent treat that is perfect for any occasion.

name: Maui Banana Bread Co
dsc: Maui Banana Bread Co's Best Seller Banana Bread 6-pack features their most popular flavors, including classic banana, chocolate chip, and macadamia nut. Each loaf is moist, flavorful, and packed with tropical goodness.

name: Grateful Bread Company
dsc: Grateful Bread Company's Sourdough Bread Assortment features four unique sourdough loaves, each with a distinct flavor profile. From classic sourdough to rosemary and olive oil, these loaves are perfect for bread lovers.

name: St-Viateur Bagel
dsc: St-Viateur Bagel's 2 dozen bagels are made using traditional Montreal methods. These bagels are boiled in honey water and baked in a wood-fired oven, resulting in a unique flavor and texture. Choose your favorite flavors for a true Montreal experience.

name: Calic Bread
dsc: Calic Bread's Monster Cream Cheese Bread is a generously filled loaf with a sweet and creamy cheese filling. This 2-pack is a unique and delicious treat that is perfect for breakfast or a sweet snack.

name: Breads Bakery
dsc: Breads Bakery's Loaf Cake Combo includes three delicious loaf cakes in a variety of flavors, such as chocolate, vanilla, and lemon. Each cake is moist, flavorful, and perfect for any occasion.

name: Pike Place Chowder
dsc: Pike Place Chowder's Sourdough Bread Bowl & Chowder Kit is a Seattle favorite. This kit includes four sourdough bread bowls and a generous portion of their award-winning clam chowder. A comforting and delicious meal for any day.

name: Arcangeli Grocery
dsc: Arcangeli Grocery's Artichoke Garlic Herb Bread is a savory loaf packed with artichoke hearts, garlic, and a blend of herbs. This 4-pack is a California favorite and is perfect for serving with pasta, soups, or as a standalone snack.

name: Lithuanian Bakery
dsc: Lithuanian Bakery's Rye Bread 4-pack features four traditional rye loaves, each with a distinct flavor and texture. These breads are made using authentic Eastern European recipes and are perfect for sandwiches or enjoying with butter.

name: Uncle Mike's Bake Shoppe
dsc: Uncle Mike's Bake Shoppe Wisconsin Spicy Cheese Bread is a deliciously spicy loaf packed with cheese and jalapeños. This bread is perfect for serving with chili, soups, or enjoying on its own as a flavorful snack.

name: Calic Bread
dsc: Calic Bread's Bagel Assortment includes a dozen freshly baked bagels in a variety of flavors. These bagels are boiled and baked to achieve a perfect chewy texture and are a great addition to any breakfast or brunch.

name: McLoons Lobster Shack
dsc: McLoons Lobster Shack offers a unique combination of a Lobster Roll Kit and Wild Maine Blueberry Bread Pudding. This kit includes fresh lobster meat, rolls, and a delicious blueberry bread pudding for dessert. A true taste of Maine.

name: The Gingered Peach
dsc: The Gingered Peach's Loaf Cakes 3-pack allows you to choose from a selection of delicious loaf cakes, including zucchini, banana, and pumpkin. Each cake is moist, flavorful, and perfect for any occasion.
